description_en: Clears the IP blacklist for a critical event protection scenario
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi clear-major-protection-black-ip --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --template-id 5132 --rule-id 20012033 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ClearMajorProtectionBlackIp

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the critical event protection scenario template.

This parameter must be set to the ID of a protection template of the critical event protection type. You can create this type of template only after purchasing the critical event protection upgrade.

For more information about how to enable critical event protection and create a critical event protection rule template, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/425591.html
parameters.help_zh:
重保防护场景模板ID。

本参数需传入重保场景防护类型的防护模板ID。重保场景防护需单独升级购买后才可创建该类型模板。

开通重保场景防护及新建重保场景防护规则模板的具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/425591.html文档
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IP blacklist rule for critical event protection
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
